title: China's Asymmetric Openness & IDAR (Introduce, Digest, Absorb, Re-innovate) Strategy Framework

stateLedMercantilism.name: State-Led Mercantilism & State Capitalism
stateLedMercantilism.definition: An economic model subordinating market mechanisms to state industrial and national security goals—leveraging global free trade outbound while imposing absolute state control inbound.

phases.name: Digestion & Absorption
phases.detail: Inflow of Western advanced technology via mandatory joint ventures, blueprint assimilation, and process replication.

phases.name: Re-innovation & Domestic Scale
phases.detail: Complete component localization, indigenous platform engineering, scale optimization, and radical cost reduction.

phases.name: Global Outbound Expansion
phases.detail: Capturing international markets with state-subsidized price competitiveness and massive supply chain scale.

asymmetricOpenness.name: Asymmetric Openness (One-Way Market Access)
asymmetricOpenness.slogan: Outbound Liberalization (Accessing Western Capital), Inbound Lockdown (Protecting Domestic Tech)
asymmetricOpenness.mechanism: Exploits Western capital mobility and open IP transactions to acquire overseas assets, while completely ring-fencing domestic strategic industries through Foreign Investment Negative Lists.

inboundMechanisms.method: Conditioned market access on establishing 50:50 joint ventures with domestic state-owned enterprises, compelling Western OEMs to transfer tooling, manufacturing know-how, and supplier networks.

cases.result: Local joint venture partners fully absorbed 40 years of German manufacturing engineering, powertrain design, and Tier-1 quality management systems.

cases.example: Japan Shinkansen (Kawasaki HI) & Siemens ICE Technology Transfer
cases.result: Assimilated high-speed rail blueprints to develop the indigenous 'Fuxing (CR400)' trainsets, subsequently exporting them to Southeast Asia and Europe.

inboundMechanisms.mechanism: 2. State-Financed Outbound M&A (Exploiting Western Capital Openness)
inboundMechanisms.method: Deployed state-backed capital and sovereign subsidies to directly acquire critical Western robotics, display, and automotive pioneers.

cases.impact: Acquired Industry 4.0 proprietary motion control algorithms, robotics source code, and automated assembly IP.
Absorbed Fringe Field Switching (FFS) wide-viewing angle LCD patents, enabling BOE to rise as the world's largest display manufacturer.
Absorbed CMA/SPA modular crash-safety platforms and ICE/EV architectures, creating the foundation for Geely, Lynk & Co, and Zeekr.

inboundMechanisms.mechanism: 3. Non-Tariff Barriers & Discriminatory Subsidies (Infant Industry Ring-Fencing)
inboundMechanisms.method: Imposed regulatory exclusions against foreign competitors until domestic champions closed the technology gap.

cases.target: South Korean NCM Battery Manufacturers (LG Chem, Samsung SDI, SK On)
cases.impact: Disqualified vehicles equipped with Korean cells from EV purchase subsidies, granting CATL and BYD an indispensable 3-year protected monopoly to achieve global scale.

outboundLegalStatutes.name: 1. Catalog of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export (MOFCOM / MOST)
outboundLegalStatutes.coreContent: Establishes a statutory list of strategic technologies prohibited from outbound licensing, cross-border data transfer, or foreign fab deployment without state authorization.

restrictedTech.item: Rare-Earth Permanent Magnet Smelting & NdFeB Processing
restrictedTech.detail: Strictly prohibits outbound transfer of rare-earth separation, purification, and high-performance sintered magnet manufacturing technology.

restrictedTech.item: LFP Battery Cathode Synthesis & Lithium Processing
restrictedTech.detail: Restricts foreign licensing and equipment exports of continuous LFP chemical formulation and automated cell assembly lines.
Classified core recommendation neural network algorithms to block IP transfers during foreign asset sales (e.g., TikTok/ByteDance).

outboundLegalStatutes.name: 2. PRC Export Control Law (ECL)
outboundLegalStatutes.coreContent: Strictly regulates outbound transfers of dual-use raw materials and critical supply chain inputs on national security grounds.

restrictedTech.detail: Imposed individual export license requirements on battery anode materials, directly constricting Western EV supply chains.
Restricted global exports of critical semiconductor substrates, power electronics elements, and military optics minerals.

outboundLegalStatutes.name: 3. Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List)
outboundLegalStatutes.coreContent: Statutorily bans foreign ownership and controlling equity investments across key domestic industrial and resource sectors.

restrictedTech.item: Strategic Mineral Mining, Rare-Earth Processing, Telecom, Defense, Nuclear
restrictedTech.detail: Establishes structural asymmetry by blocking foreign acquisitions of domestic critical infrastructure while Chinese SOEs freely acquire Western peers.

outboundLegalStatutes.name: 4. Data Security Law (DSL) & Revised Counter-Espionage Law
outboundLegalStatutes.coreContent: Classifies manufacturing telemetry, supply chain mapping, and software source code generated within China as protected state secrets, prohibiting cross-border transmission.

restrictedTech.item: Auditing & Supply Chain Due Diligence Raids (Bain, Mintz Group)
restrictedTech.detail: Criminalized independent Western supply chain investigations as espionage, severing Western corporate headquarters from local operational visibility.

systemicWeaponization.title: Systemic Asymmetry as a Geopolitical Weapon
systemicWeaponization.explanation: Leveraged Western capital market openness and IP protections to acquire critical technologies, then fortified domestic infrastructure behind national security firewalls and export control statutes.

deriskingRootCause.title: The Structural Imperative for Western De-risking
deriskingRootCause.explanation: US and European defensive trade and investment screening statutes (IRA, CHIPS Act, EU CRMA, FDI Screening) represent essential defensive safeguards against asymmetric technology capture and supply chain weaponization.
